new_policies.name: student-template-home-interceptor-v2-normal
new_policies.description: Corrected public home-interception schedule with legal enemy shuttle-reset detours and unchanged opening prior.
new_policies.model: Unchanged source-template Flag/Bomb prior plus public stationary-piece home-interception schedule. Intact two-Bomb corner screen and exactly one routed disclosed Miner at least3actions away. After each quiet candidate require guarddistance+2<=MinerFlagdistance, or no invasion route. Certify alternatives against disclosed actor/guard threats; demote only failed schedules below the best certified quiet move. Captures, immediatewins, currenturgentFlagdefense and all rawschedule-feasible scores remain unchanged. No search/world additions or persistent garrison role. Enemy Miner ETA uses an initial/later route state with origin vacated, so a legal initial detour can reset a binding two-square ban; guard distance remains conservative simple-path.
new_policies.information_model: Own army, source-informed population prior and public events only. No enemy setup, referee position or private deployment seed.

hypotheses: Retaining time to deploy a capable home interceptor against an already disclosed Miner converts more games than the same opening-inference policy without that scheduling correction.
analysis: Fresh fixed-sample exploratory one-contrast screen. Exact algorithm and qualification frozen before games; no tuning on this cohort. Primary paired score comparison,95% interval and missing-error sensitivity; no promotion without fresh independent final validation. The filter holds other pieces stationary and does not guarantee global safety: hidden threats, future enemy coordination and offensive Flag races remain unmodeled. It is a desktop strategic prototype with no CX16 fit claim. All score changes concern failed quiet response schedules; actor safety only certifies alternatives, so there is no independent generic tactical-risk intervention. Honest guard stress tests are separate from DOS results. Version1 was rejected before any games after a shuttle-reset counterexample. Version2 uses a new immutableID; unchanged algorithm apart from exact stationary-piece enemy ETA and its regression fixtures. No version1 strength result exists.
evidence: research/home-reserve-runtime-v2/CONCLUSION.md and predecessor preservedversion1 rejection. Fifteenmechanicaltests and fouradaptertests pass, including exactlegal detours and finite-but-overestimatedv1ETA. Source-only repair before strengthgames; same screeningcohort contained no binding disclosed-Miner shuttle cases.
